NARRATIVE:

On 01/04/2017 a concerned citizen called regarding possible illegal activity at the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] restaurant in Escanaba, MI. On 01/15/2017 agents from the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Border Patrol station were able to locate two [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] es in the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] restaurant parking lot with TN license plates (TN: [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and TN: ) registered to [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] . The registered owner of the vehicles returned with very little information which [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Agents have discovered is an indication of illegal alienage. [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Agents [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] On 07/02/2017 [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] the two TN plated vehicles that were located behind the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] restaurant. The vehicles were followed to a home located at [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] in Escanaba, MI. On 09/04/2017 agents received information that a subject at the [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] residence had been arrested and is being held in the Delta County Jail. The subject was found to be an illegal alien and ICE has placed a detainer on the subject [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] . On 09/07/2017 agents [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] and followed the vehicle plated [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] from that location. The vehicle stopped near the intersection of [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] in Escanaba, MI. The two subjects exited the vehicle as Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] approached and identified themselves as United States Border Patrol Agents and performed a consensual encounter with the two occupants of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security Continuation Page for Form ___________________ I213 Alien’s Name F [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] Date [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] 09/07/2017 Event No [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] vehicle. The two occupants of the vehicle were identified as [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] . Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] asked each individual what country they were citizens of and both indicated they were Mexican citizens. Both subjects were asked if they had any immigration documents to be in the United States legally and both stated they did not. The subjects were asked if they were in the United States legally or illegally and both stated they were in the United States illegally. Neither subject could produce any documentation that permitted them to be in, pass through, work or remain in the United States legally. [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] were transported to the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Border Patrol station for processing.

[REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] (along with his property) will be held at the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] County Jail pending removal proceedings. [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] did not receive a bond due the new Executive Order Implementing the President's Border Security and Immigration Enforcement Policies dated February 20, 2017. [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] appeared to be lucid and in good health.
